title: LeCun says Amodei wants open models made illegal
summary: Yann LeCun’s post answers a clip of Dario Amodei that is being shared as new. In July, Amodei wrote that Anthropic has never advocated a ban.

topics.angle: The loudest accusation, and the answer already on record.

claims.text: Open models would be made illegal and Amodei would stay in control: LeCun’s account of Amodei’s motive.
LeCun was answering a post that presents the clip as congressional testimony and gives no date.
The clip is from a Senate hearing on July 25, 2023.
On July 27, 2026 Amodei wrote: “Anthropic has never advocated for a ban on open-weights models.”
The same post says open-weight models are harder to guard and cannot be withdrawn once released.

to_find: The 2023 hearing video, watched, to confirm the clip’s date and words
Any reply from Amodei or Anthropic since November 22
would_change: The clip proving to be recent, or a new statement from Anthropic.
